name: Six-Cell Flashlight
text: Heavy as a club, bright as a lighthouse. +1 nerve on every roll.
art: A heavy black six-cell flashlight throwing a hard white beam across a dark suburban lawn

name: Insomnia Mix '86
text: Ninety minutes of synth-pop guaranteed to keep you awake. Wards against dream encounters.
art: A hand-labeled cassette mixtape reading Insomnia Mix 86 in glitter pen, glowing faintly in a Walkman

name: Blessed Super Soaker
text: A neon squirt gun filled at St. Jude's, no questions asked. Wards against paranormal encounters.
art: A neon orange squirt gun filled with faintly glowing holy water, a tiny cross sticker on the tank

name: Silver Lamé Scrunchie
text: Real silver thread, from the Glitter Box costume shop. Wards against creature encounters.
art: A shimmering silver lamé scrunchie on a teenager's wrist, catching moonlight

name: Pocket Cassette Recorder
text: Catches voices you cannot hear. +1 lore on every roll.
art: A pocket cassette recorder with its red record light on, its tape reels turning by themselves

name: Instant Camera
text: Shows what was really there. +1 brains on every roll.
art: A white instant camera spitting out a photo that shows a ghostly shape hidden to the naked eye

name: Little League Bat
text: Signed by the 1979 Glimmer Falls Gophers. +1 brawn on every roll.
art: A dented aluminum little league baseball bat covered in team signatures leaning on a garage door

name: Aqua-Glow Max Hold
text: Hairspray strong enough to stop a slasher in their tracks. Wards against slasher encounters.
art: A tall can of glittering hairspray with a lightning-bolt label, a cloud of shimmering mist

name: Walkie-Talkies
text: Channel 9, over. +1 hustle on every roll.
art: A pair of chunky yellow walkie-talkies with long antennas crackling with static

name: Raven's Spare Tarot
text: The Tower keeps coming up. +1 lore on every roll.
art: A worn tarot deck fanned on black velvet, the Tower card glowing on top

name: Lucky Leg Warmers
text: Rainbow-striped confidence. +1 charm on every roll.
art: A pair of rainbow-striped leg warmers over high-top sneakers mid-dance step

name: Rock Salt
text: A coffee can of it, for circles on the floor. Wards against cult encounters.
art: A coffee can of rock salt and a white salt circle poured on a basement floor

name: Tinfoil Hat
text: Laugh all you want. Wards against cosmic encounters.
art: A lovingly crafted tinfoil hat with antenna coils, shining under a starry sky

name: Debug Disk
text: A 5.25-inch floppy labeled DO NOT RUN. Wards against tech encounters.
art: A black 5.25 inch floppy disk with a handwritten red warning label, glowing green code reflected on it

name: Glow-Stick Bracelets
text: Neon courage from the Glitter Box gift shop. Wards against camp encounters.
art: A stack of neon pink, green and blue glow-stick bracelets on a raised fist in the dark

name: Bandages and Bactine
text: Use from your pack for +2 nerve.
art: A cartoon-patterned bandage tin and a spray bottle of antiseptic on a bathroom counter

name: Bolt Cola
text: All the sugar and twice the caffeine. Use from your pack for +1 nerve and -1 dread.
art: A sweating red can of Bolt Cola with a lightning bolt logo fizzing over
